test_cases.title: Verify GUI stores event log in non-volatile memory
steps: Invoke the function to write event log data to non-volatile memory.
Assert that the non-volatile memory contains the event log data.
Verify that the data can be read back from non-volatile memory and matches the original input.
expected: The non-volatile memory should contain the event log data.
The read data should match the input 'eventLogData'.

test_cases.title: Verify event log includes all confirmed ventilation settings
steps: Invoke the function to log ventilation settings.
Assert that the event log contains the 'ventilationSettings' provided.
Check that all elements in the event log are confirmed settings.
expected: The event log should include the 'ventilationSettings' provided.
All elements in the event log should be confirmed settings.

test_cases.title: Verify event log includes a date and timestamp
steps: Invoke the function to log the current date and time.
Assert that the event log contains the current date and time.
Check that the date and time are present in the event log.
expected: The event log should contain the current date and time.
The date and time should be present in the event log.

test_cases.title: Verify event log includes changes to the system's real time clock
steps: Invoke the function to log the current date and time.
Invoke the function to log the new date and time (one hour ahead).
Assert that the event log contains both date and time entries.
Check that the new date and time are one hour ahead of the current date and time.
expected: The event log should contain both the current date and time and the new date and time.
The new date and time should be exactly one hour ahead of the current date and time.

test_cases.title: Verify event log does not include unconfirmed ventilation settings
steps: Invoke the function to log ventilation settings.
Assert that the event log does not contain the 'unconfirmedSettings'.
expected: The event log should not include the 'unconfirmedSettings'.

test_cases.title: Verify event log does not contain incorrect or outdated timestamps
steps: Invoke the function to log an outdated date and time.
Assert that the event log does not contain the outdated date and time.
Check that the event log only contains the current date and time.
expected: The event log should not contain the outdated date and time.
The event log should only contain the current date and time.

test_cases.title: Verify event log storage integrity after multiple writes and reads
steps: Write multiple event logs to non-volatile memory.
Read back the non-volatile memory multiple times.
Assert that the read data matches the original input for each write operation.
Check for data corruption or loss after multiple writes and reads.
expected: After multiple writes and reads, the non-volatile memory should maintain the integrity of the event logs.
No data corruption or loss should be observed.

test_cases.title: Verify event log handles concurrent writes
steps: Simulate concurrent writes to non-volatile memory.
Read back the non-volatile memory.
Assert that the read data matches the original input for each write operation.
Check for data corruption or loss after concurrent writes.
expected: After concurrent writes, the non-volatile memory should maintain the integrity of the event logs.
No data corruption or loss should be observed.

test_cases.title: Verify event log timestamp accuracy after system time changes

Assert that the event log contains the new date and time.
Check that the date and time in the event log are updated correctly after the system time change.
expected: The event log should contain the new date and time after the system time change.
The date and time in the event log should accurately reflect the system time change.
